description:

See report Tier 3 for the full list.

## Orchestrator scoping (synthesized 2026-07-25 by /orchestrate-epic from verified code analysis)

Every sub-item enumerated to its file and function. All symbols verified present at the cited lines.

|---|---|---|

Also `state.modules \|\| state.modules_fn.()` at :285. `disarmed_notice/0` at :162-167, single caller at :123. |
| 5 | collapse `collect_lines/2` ladder | `lib/specled_ex/coverage/mfa_lines.ex:64-83` — an 8-clause ladder including a hand-written tuple-arity cascade at :74-79 (`{a,b,c,d,e}` / `{a,b,c,d}` / `{a,b,c}` / `{a,b}` / `other -> Tuple.to_list`). Entry point at :50. |

| 7 | `:ets.info(tid, :size)` | Two full-`:ets.info/1` calls used only as liveness probes: `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex:123` (`table_alive?/1`) and `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:418` (`load_boundary_index/0`). `:ets.info/1` builds the whole info list; `:ets.info/2` does not. |

Resolve ownership before either starts. |
| 10 | rescue-based boundary insert + `head/1` tolerance | `boundary.ex:68-80` — the `if table_alive?(config.boundary_table) do` pre-check is a TOCTOU window; replace with a `rescue ArgumentError` around `:ets.insert/2` at :79. `head/1` at :39-48 has **no** tolerance: `modules_for/1`'s `:ets.insert` at :117 raises if the table died. |
| 11 | `boundary_key/1` `setup_all` fallback | `lib/specled_ex/coverage.ex:69-71` — a single clause `defp boundary_key(%{module: mod, test: name}) when is_atom(mod) and is_atom(name)`. An ExUnit `setup_all` context has `:module` but **no** `:test`, so wiring the hook via `setup_all` raises `FunctionClauseError`. Reached from `per_test_boundary/1:58`, which is the documented public API (`lib/specled_ex/case.ex:18`). |
| 12 | document declare-the-hook-FIRST | `docs/coverage.md:185-217` ("Wiring the per-test boundary hook") — shows the setup line but never says it must be declared before other `setup` callbacks. Same content is duplicated in `lib/specled_ex/coverage.ex:5-15` (moduledoc) and `lib/specled_ex/case.ex:2-14`. |
| 13 | publish one measured per-test overhead figure | `docs/coverage.md:171-177` ("**Cost model.**") — qualitative only, no number. **Same paragraph dn4.6/F14 rewrites.** |
| 14 | meta shape validation at `classify_v2` | `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex:329-337` — `classify_v2/1` does `Map.put_new(envelope, :meta, %{})` with no check that an existing `:meta` is a map, while the sibling validator at :320-326 does assert `is_list` on `:files`/`:mfas`. | 15 | non-loading source resolution | `coverage_triangulation.ex:407-421` `module_source_file/1` calls `Code.ensure_loaded(mod)` — a **side effect** inside a function whose own docstring at :265 says *"Pure: no filesystem access."* Same pattern at `formatter.ex:269`. |
| 16 | fixture mkdir hardening | **Could not pin to a unique site — the consolidated report is authoritative.** Candidates, in order of likelihood: `test/specled_ex/coverage/mfa_lines_test.exs:9-35` (`File.mkdir_p!` then an `on_exit` that hand-walks `File.ls!` and calls `File.rmdir` rather than `File.rm_rf`, so any unexpected file leaks the dir); `test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs` scaffolds at :406-407, :434-435, :476-477, :589-590 (create only `lib/` and `test/`, never `.spec/`); `test/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot_test.exs:217`. |
